clocktower.hint_1.title: Dear evil, target the trusted
clocktower.hint_1.header: Eliminate players who are trusted by town.
clocktower.hint_1.body: A trusted or proven player who makes it to the end of the game will not get any votes. Choose your final three wisely.
clocktower.hint_2.title: Death is not the end in Blood on the Clocktower...
clocktower.hint_2.header: Dead players are still part of the game.
clocktower.hint_2.body: Do your best not to discount them. Sometimes they can have game-solving information!
clocktower.hint_3.title: Know your role... or the role you are bluffing
clocktower.hint_3.header: The Storyteller will not lie to you about rules.
clocktower.hint_3.body: If you have questions about your character or interactions, ask the Storyteller privately or publicly. Know how to use your information or how to lie about it.
clocktower.hint_4.title: Keep an eye on the votes
clocktower.hint_4.header: Pay attention to when people vote and who they vote on.
clocktower.hint_4.body: While it is essential for a Butler to pay attention to voting, all characters can gather information about who players trust or distrust based on their voting habits.
clocktower.hint_5.title: Don't take it personally...
clocktower.hint_5.header: Sometimes the best thing you can do for your team is die.
clocktower.hint_5.body: A Townsfolk nominating a Virgin, a Minion falling on their sword for their Demon, or an Imp choosing themselves to die can all benefit their respective teams.
clocktower.hint_6.title: Anyone can claim anything
clocktower.hint_6.header: Characters that are required to claim publicly can be bluffed by anyone.
clocktower.hint_6.body: In Trouble Brewing, anyone can claim to be the Slayer and "shoot" another player.
clocktower.hint_7.title: Advice on the Wiki
clocktower.hint_7.header: The wiki offers valuable advice for every character.
clocktower.hint_7.body: Whether you are the character, or bluffing as it, the wiki has tips and tricks you can use to guide your actions.
clocktower.hint_8.title:
Kill with grace
Die with dignity
clocktower.hint_8.header: Always remember: it's just a game.
clocktower.hint_8.body: Players are only playing the token they draw. Laugh, learn, and then rack up another game.
clocktower.hint_9.title: Misregistration Mayhem
clocktower.hint_9.header: Certain characters can be seen as other characters.
clocktower.hint_9.body: The Recluse *can* register as Evil or an Evil character and the Spy *can* register as Good or a Good character. It is up to the Storyteller if that happens and does not need to be consistent.
clocktower.hint_10.title: Final Four
clocktower.hint_10.header: Be careful who you execute, *if* you execute.
clocktower.hint_10.body: If you execute the wrong player when just four players live, the Demon only has to successfully kill one player to win the game.
clocktower.hint_11.title: Executions are necessary for Good to win
clocktower.hint_11.header: Good will not win if they do not execute.
clocktower.hint_11.body: Every executed player is decided by the votes of town, rather than chosen by the Demon.
clocktower.hint_12.title: One of a kind
clocktower.hint_12.header: Each character can only be in the game once.
clocktower.hint_12.body: Different characters have incentive to lie about themselves to trick the Evil Team. Although three people may be claiming Ravenkeeper, there cannot be more than one.

clocktower.role.scapegoat.desc: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
clocktower.role.gunslinger.desc: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
clocktower.role.beggar.desc: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
clocktower.role.bureaucrat.desc: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
clocktower.role.thief.desc: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
clocktower.role.butcher.desc: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
clocktower.role.bonecollector.desc: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
clocktower.role.harlot.desc: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
clocktower.role.barista.desc: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.
clocktower.role.deviant.desc: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.
clocktower.role.apprentice.desc: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).
clocktower.role.matron.desc: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
clocktower.role.voudon.desc: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50 percent majority isn't required.
clocktower.role.judge.desc: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.
clocktower.role.bishop.desc: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
clocktower.role.cacklejack.desc: Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character tonight.
clocktower.role.gangster.desc: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbor, if your other alive neighbor agrees.
clocktower.role.gnome.desc: All players start knowing a player of your alignment. You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.
clocktower.role.washerwoman.desc: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
clocktower.role.librarian.desc: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
clocktower.role.investigator.desc: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
clocktower.role.chef.desc: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
clocktower.role.empath.desc: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
clocktower.role.fortuneteller.desc: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
clocktower.role.undertaker.desc: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
clocktower.role.monk.desc: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
clocktower.role.ravenkeeper.desc: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
clocktower.role.virgin.desc: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
clocktower.role.slayer.desc: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
clocktower.role.soldier.desc: You are safe from the Demon.
clocktower.role.mayor.desc: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
clocktower.role.clockmaker.desc: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.
clocktower.role.dreamer.desc: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
clocktower.role.snakecharmer.desc: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & then is poisoned.
clocktower.role.mathematician.desc: Each night, you learn how many players' abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
clocktower.role.flowergirl.desc: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.
clocktower.role.towncrier.desc: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
clocktower.role.oracle.desc: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
clocktower.role.savant.desc: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
clocktower.role.seamstress.desc: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
clocktower.role.philosopher.desc: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
clocktower.role.artist.desc: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
clocktower.role.juggler.desc: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
clocktower.role.sage.desc: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
clocktower.role.grandmother.desc: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
clocktower.role.sailor.desc: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
clocktower.role.chambermaid.desc: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
clocktower.role.exorcist.desc: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
clocktower.role.innkeeper.desc: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
clocktower.role.gambler.desc: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
clocktower.role.gossip.desc: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
clocktower.role.courtier.desc: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
clocktower.role.professor.desc: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
clocktower.role.minstrel.desc: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
clocktower.role.tealady.desc: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.
clocktower.role.pacifist.desc: Executed good players might not die.
clocktower.role.fool.desc: The 1st time you die, you don't.
clocktower.role.acrobat.desc: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.
clocktower.role.alchemist.desc: You have a minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
clocktower.role.alsaahir.desc: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and Demon(s), good wins.
clocktower.role.amnesiac.desc: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
clocktower.role.atheist.desc: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. §7[No §7evil §7characters]§r
clocktower.role.balloonist.desc: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. §7[+0 §7or §7+1 §7Outsider]§r
clocktower.role.banshee.desc: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.
clocktower.role.bountyhunter.desc: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. §7[+1 §7Townsfolk §7is §7evil.]§r
clocktower.role.cannibal.desc: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
clocktower.role.choirboy.desc: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. §7[+the §7King]§r
clocktower.role.cultleader.desc: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
clocktower.role.engineer.desc: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
clocktower.role.farmer.desc: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
clocktower.role.fisherman.desc: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
clocktower.role.general.desc: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.
clocktower.role.highpriestess.desc: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
clocktower.role.huntsman.desc: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. §7[+the §7Damsel]§r
clocktower.role.king.desc: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.
clocktower.role.knight.desc: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
clocktower.role.lycanthrope.desc: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn't kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.
clocktower.role.magician.desc: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
clocktower.role.nightwatchman.desc: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn that you are the Nightwatchman.
clocktower.role.noble.desc: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
clocktower.role.pixie.desc: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
clocktower.role.poppygrower.desc: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
clocktower.role.princess.desc: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.
clocktower.role.preacher.desc: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.
clocktower.role.shugenja.desc: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
clocktower.role.villageidiot.desc: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. §7[+0 §7to §7+2 §7Village §7Idiots. §71 §7of §7the §7extras §7is §7drunk]§r
clocktower.role.butler.desc: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
clocktower.role.saint.desc: If you die by execution, your team loses.
clocktower.role.recluse.desc: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
clocktower.role.drunk.desc: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
clocktower.role.mutant.desc: If you are "mad" about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
clocktower.role.sweetheart.desc: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
clocktower.role.barber.desc: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
clocktower.role.klutz.desc: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
clocktower.role.goon.desc: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until Dusk. You become their alignment.
clocktower.role.lunatic.desc: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
clocktower.role.tinker.desc: You might die at any time.
clocktower.role.moonchild.desc: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
clocktower.role.damsel.desc: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
clocktower.role.golem.desc: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.
clocktower.role.hatter.desc: If you died today or tonight, the Minion & Demon players may choose new Minion & Demon characters to be.
clocktower.role.heretic.desc: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins even if you are dead.
clocktower.role.ogre.desc: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.
clocktower.role.plaguedoctor.desc: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.
clocktower.role.politician.desc: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.
clocktower.role.puzzlemaster.desc: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.
clocktower.role.zealot.desc: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.
clocktower.role.poisoner.desc: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
clocktower.role.spy.desc: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
clocktower.role.baron.desc: There are extra Outsiders in play. §7[+2 §7Outsiders]§r
clocktower.role.scarletwoman.desc: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon.
clocktower.role.eviltwin.desc: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
clocktower.role.witch.desc: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
clocktower.role.cerenovus.desc: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are "mad" they are this character tomorrow, or they might be executed.
clocktower.role.pithag.desc: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
clocktower.role.godfather.desc: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. §7[§7-1 §7or §7+1 §7Outsider]§r
clocktower.role.devilsadvocate.desc: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
clocktower.role.assassin.desc: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
clocktower.role.mastermind.desc: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
clocktower.role.boffin.desc: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character's ability. You both know which.
clocktower.role.boomdandy.desc: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.
clocktower.role.fearmonger.desc: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.
clocktower.role.goblin.desc: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
clocktower.role.harpy.desc: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.
clocktower.role.marionette.desc: You think you are a good character but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. §7[You §7neighbor §7the §7Demon]§r
clocktower.role.mezepheles.desc: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.
clocktower.role.organgrinder.desc: All players keep their eyes closed when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.
clocktower.role.psychopath.desc: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
clocktower.role.summoner.desc: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. §7[No §7Demon]§r
clocktower.role.vizier.desc: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.
clocktower.role.widow.desc: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.
clocktower.role.wizard.desc: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.
clocktower.role.xaan.desc: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk. §7[X §7Outsiders]§r
clocktower.role.imp.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
clocktower.role.fanggu.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. §7[+1 §7Outsider]§r
clocktower.role.vigormortis.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. §7[-1 §7Outsider]§r
clocktower.role.nodashii.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.
clocktower.role.vortox.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
clocktower.role.zombuul.desc: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
clocktower.role.pukka.desc: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
clocktower.role.shabaloth.desc: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
clocktower.role.po.desc: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
clocktower.role.alhadikhia.desc: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.
clocktower.role.kazali.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. §7[You §7choose §7which §7players §7are §7which §7Minions. §7-? §7to §7+? §7Outsiders]
clocktower.role.legion.desc: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. §7[Most §7players §7are §7Legion]§r
clocktower.role.leviathan.desc: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
clocktower.role.lilmonsta.desc: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. §7[+1 §7Minion]§r
clocktower.role.lleech.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing a player: they are poisoned. You die if & only if they are dead.
clocktower.role.lordoftyphon.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. §7[Evil §7characters §7are §7in §7a §7line. §7You §7are §7in §7the §7middle. §7+1 §7Minion. §7-? §7to §7+? §7Outsiders]§r
clocktower.role.ojo.desc: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.
clocktower.role.riot.desc: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.
clocktower.role.yaggababble.desc: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you said it publicly today, a player might die.

clocktower.role.angel.name: Angel
clocktower.role.buddhist.name: Buddhist

clocktower.role.doomsayer.desc: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.
clocktower.role.angel.desc: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.
clocktower.role.buddhist.desc: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.
clocktower.role.hellslibrarian.desc: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller has asked for silence.
clocktower.role.revolutionary.desc: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, 1 of them registers falsely.
clocktower.role.fiddler.desc: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.
clocktower.role.toymaker.desc: The Demon may choose not to attack & must do this at least once per game. Evil players get normal starting info.
clocktower.role.fibbin.desc: Once per game, 1 good player might get incorrect information.
clocktower.role.duchess.desc: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.
clocktower.role.sentinel.desc: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outisder in play.
clocktower.role.spiritofivory.desc: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
clocktower.role.djinn.desc: Use the Djinn's special rule. All players know what it is.
clocktower.role.bootlegger.desc: This script has homebrew characters or rules.
clocktower.role.deusexfiasco.desc: At least once per game, the Storyteller will make a mistake, correct it, and publicly admit to it.
clocktower.role.ferryman.desc: On the final day, all dead players regain their vote token.
clocktower.role.gardener.desc: The Storyteller assigns 1 or more players' characters.
clocktower.role.stormcatcher.desc: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.
clocktower.role.bigwig.desc: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.
clocktower.role.godofug.desc: One Ug hat. When wear Ug hat, must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If fail, pass Ug hat.
clocktower.role.hindu.desc: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.
clocktower.role.knaves.desc: There are 2 Storytellers: one lies & one tells the truth. Once per game, at dusk, they might switch.
clocktower.role.pope.desc: There are duplicate good characters in play. They might also be bluffs.
clocktower.role.tor.desc: Players don't know their character or alignment. They learn them when they die.
clocktower.role.ventriloquist.desc: If a player is mad as a fresh character during their nomination, they might not die if executed today.
clocktower.role.zenomancer.desc: One or more players each have a goal. When achieved, that player learns a piece of true info.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-boffin: If the Alchemist has the Boffin ability, the Alchemist does not learn what ability the Demon has.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-marionette: An Alchemist-Marionette has no Marionette ability & the Marionette is in play.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-mastermind: An Alchemist-Mastermind has no Mastermind ability & the Mastermind is not-in-play.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-organgrinder: If the Alchemist has the Organ Grinder ability, the Organ Grinder is in play. If both are sober, both are drunk.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-spy: An Alchemist-Spy has no Spy ability & a Spy is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Spy may publicly guess a living player as the Spy. If correct, the Demon must choose the Spy tonight.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-summoner: The Alchemist-Summoner does not get bluffs, and chooses which Demon but not which player. If they die before this happens, evil wins. [No Demon]
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-widow: An Alchemist-Widow has no Widow ability & a Widow is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Widow may publicly guess a living player as the Widow. If correct, the Demon must choose the Widow tonight.
clocktower.jinx.alchemist-wraith: An Alchemist-Wraith has no Wraith ability & a Wraith is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Wraith may publicly guess a living player as the Wraith. If correct, the Demon must choose the Wraith tonight.
clocktower.jinx.alhadikhia-mastermind: If the Al-Hadikhia dies by execution, and the Mastermind is alive, the Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 good players tonight: if all 3 choose to live, evil wins. Otherwise, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.alhadikhia-princess: If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, no one dies to the Al-Hadikhia tonight.
clocktower.jinx.alhadikhia-scarletwoman: If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman becomes the Scarlet Woman again.
clocktower.jinx.alsaahir-vizier: The Storyteller doesn't declare the Vizier is in play.
clocktower.jinx.atheist-riot: During a riot, if the Storyteller is nominated, players vote. If they are "about to die", the game ends. If not, they nominate again.
clocktower.jinx.balloonist-marionette: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, an Outsider might have been added during setup.
clocktower.jinx.banshee-leviathan: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
clocktower.jinx.banshee-riot: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
clocktower.jinx.banshee-vortox: If the Vortox kills the Banshee, all players learn that the Banshee has died.
clocktower.jinx.baron-heretic: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
clocktower.jinx.baron-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Baron ability, up to two players become Outsiders.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-cultleader: If the Demon has the Cult Leader ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-drunk: The Demon cannot have the Drunk ability.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-goon: If the Demon has the Goon ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-heretic: The Demon cannot have the Heretic ability.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-ogre: The Demon cannot have the Ogre ability.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-politician: The Demon cannot have the Politician ability.
clocktower.jinx.boffin-villageidiot: If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Village Idiot ability.
clocktower.jinx.boomdandy-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Boomdandy ability, a player becomes the Boomdandy.
clocktower.jinx.bountyhunter-kazali: If the Kazali turns the Bounty Hunter into a Minion, an evil Townsfolk is not created.
clocktower.jinx.bountyhunter-philosopher: If the Philosopher gains the Bounty Hunter ability, a Townsfolk might turn evil.
clocktower.jinx.butler-cannibal: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
clocktower.jinx.butler-organgrinder: If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Butler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.
clocktower.jinx.cannibal-juggler: If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.
clocktower.jinx.cannibal-princess: If the Cannibal nominated, executed, & killed the Princess today, the Demon doesn’t kill tonight.
clocktower.jinx.cannibal-zealot: If the Cannibal gains the Zealot ability, the Cannibal learns this.
clocktower.jinx.cerenovus-goblin: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.
clocktower.jinx.chambermaid-mathematicia: The Chambermaid can detect if the Mathematician will wake tonight.
clocktower.jinx.clockmaker-summoner: The Summoner registers as the Demon to the Clockmaker.
clocktower.jinx.courtier-summoner: If the living Summoner has no ability, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
clocktower.jinx.courtier-vizier: If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
clocktower.jinx.cultleader-pithag: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Cult Leader, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
clocktower.jinx.damsel-pithag: If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
clocktower.jinx.damsel-spy: If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
clocktower.jinx.damsel-widow: If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
clocktower.jinx.drunk-mathematician: The Mathematician might learn if the Drunk's ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
clocktower.jinx.engineer-legion: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Engineer starts knowing this but has no ability.
clocktower.jinx.engineer-summoner: If the living Summoner is removed from play, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
clocktower.jinx.eviltwin-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Evil Twin ability, a player becomes the Evil Twin.
clocktower.jinx.exorcist-leviathan: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.exorcist-riot: If Riot nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.exorcist-yaggababble: If the Exorcist chooses the Yaggababble, the Yaggababble does not kill tonight.
clocktower.jinx.fanggu-scarletwoman: If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman remains the Scarlet Woman.
clocktower.jinx.farmer-leviathan: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
clocktower.jinx.farmer-riot: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
clocktower.jinx.fearmonger-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Fearmonger ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
clocktower.jinx.fearmonger-vizier: The Vizier wakes with the Fearmonger, learns who they choose and cannot choose to immediately execute that player.
clocktower.jinx.goblin-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Goblin ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
clocktower.jinx.godfather-heretic: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
clocktower.jinx.goon-pithag: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Goon, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
clocktower.jinx.grandmother-leviathan: If the Leviathan is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
clocktower.jinx.grandmother-riot: If Riot is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
clocktower.jinx.hatter-legion: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Hatter has no ability.
clocktower.jinx.hatter-leviathan: The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
clocktower.jinx.hatter-lilmonsta: If the Hatter dies & the Demon chooses Lil' Monsta, they also choose a Minion to become.
clocktower.jinx.hatter-summoner: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
clocktower.jinx.heretic-lleech: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
clocktower.jinx.heretic-pithag: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
clocktower.jinx.heretic-spy: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
clocktower.jinx.heretic-widow: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
clocktower.jinx.huntsman-marionette: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added during setup.
clocktower.jinx.innkeeper-leviathan: If the Leviathan nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.innkeeper-riot: If Riot nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.investigator-vizier: The Storyteller doesn't declare the Vizier is in play.
clocktower.jinx.kazali-marionette: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
clocktower.jinx.kazali-summoner: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
clocktower.jinx.king-leviathan: If the Leviathan is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
clocktower.jinx.king-riot: If Riot is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
clocktower.jinx.legion-magician: The Magician wakes with Legion and might register as evil. Legion knows if a Magician is in play, but not which player it is.
clocktower.jinx.legion-minstrel: If Legion died by execution today, Legion keeps their ability, but the Minstrel might learn they are Legion.
clocktower.jinx.legion-politician: The Politician might register as evil to Legion.
clocktower.jinx.legion-preacher: If the Preacher chooses Legion, Legion keeps their ability, but the Preacher might learn they are Legion.
clocktower.jinx.legion-summoner: If Legion is summoned, all evil players become Legion.
clocktower.jinx.legion-zealot: The Zealot might register as evil to Legion.
clocktower.jinx.leviathan-mayor: If the Leviathan and the Mayor are alive on day 5 & no execution occurs, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.leviathan-monk: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.leviathan-pithag: The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
clocktower.jinx.leviathan-ravenkeeper: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
clocktower.jinx.leviathan-sage: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
clocktower.jinx.leviathan-soldier: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.lilmonsta-magician: If the Magician is alive, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.
clocktower.jinx.lilmonsta-marionette: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
clocktower.jinx.lilmonsta-poppygrower: If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
clocktower.jinx.lilmonsta-psychopath: If the Psychopath is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
clocktower.jinx.lilmonsta-scarletwoman: If Lil' Monsta dies with 5 or more players alive, the Scarlet Woman babysits Lil' Monsta for the rest of the game.
clocktower.jinx.lilmonsta-vizier: If the Vizier is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
clocktower.jinx.lleech-mastermind: If the Mastermind is alive and the Lleech host dies by execution, the Lleech lives but loses their ability.
clocktower.jinx.lleech-slayer: If the Slayer slays the Lleech host, the host dies.
clocktower.jinx.lordoftyphon-summoner: If a Lord of Typhon is summoned, they must neighbor a Minion & their other neighbor becomes an evil Minion.
clocktower.jinx.lunatic-mathematician: The Mathematician might learn if the Lunatic attacks a different player than the real Demon attacked.
clocktower.jinx.magician-marionette: If the Magician is alive, the Demon doesn't know which neighbor is the Marionette.
clocktower.jinx.magician-spy: When the Spy sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
clocktower.jinx.magician-vizier: If the Vizier is in play, the Magician has no ability but is immune to the Vizier's ability.
clocktower.jinx.magician-widow: When the Widow sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
clocktower.jinx.magician-wraith: After each execution, the living Magician may publicly guess a living player as the Wraith. If correct, the Demon must choose the Wraith tonight.
clocktower.jinx.marionette-mathematician: The Mathematician might learn if the Marionette's ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
clocktower.jinx.marionette-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Marionette ability, one of the Demon's good neighbors becomes the Marionette.
clocktower.jinx.marionette-summoner: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
clocktower.jinx.mastermind-vigormortis: A Mastermind that has their ability keeps it if the Vigormortis dies.
clocktower.jinx.mayor-riot: The Mayor may choose to stop the riot. If they do so when only 1 Riot is alive, good wins. Otherwise, evil wins.
clocktower.jinx.monk-riot: If Riot nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.ogre-pithag: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Ogre, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
clocktower.jinx.ogre-recluse: If the Recluse registers as evil to the Ogre, the Ogre learns that they are evil.
clocktower.jinx.ogre-spy: The Spy registers as evil to the Ogre.
clocktower.jinx.pithag-politician: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Politician, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
clocktower.jinx.pithag-summoner: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
clocktower.jinx.pithag-villageidiot: If there is a spare token, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Village Idiot. If so, the drunk Village Idiot might change.
clocktower.jinx.plaguedoctor-scarletwoma: If the Storyteller would gain the Scarlet Woman ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
clocktower.jinx.plaguedoctor-spy: If the Storyteller would gain the Spy ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
clocktower.jinx.plaguedoctor-wraith: If the Storyteller would gain the Wraith ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
clocktower.jinx.politician-vizier: The Politician might register as evil to the Vizier.
clocktower.jinx.poppygrower-spy: If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Spy does not see the Grimoire.
clocktower.jinx.poppygrower-summoner: If the Poppy Grower is alive on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon but not which player.
clocktower.jinx.poppygrower-widow: If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Widow does not see the Grimoire.
clocktower.jinx.preacher-summoner: If the living Summoner has no ability, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
clocktower.jinx.preacher-vizier: If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
clocktower.jinx.pukka-summoner: The Summoner may summon a Pukka on the 2nd night instead of the 3rd.
clocktower.jinx.ravenkeeper-riot: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
clocktower.jinx.recluse-sage: The Recluse might register as the Demon to the Sage.
clocktower.jinx.riot-sage: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
clocktower.jinx.riot-soldier: If Riot nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
clocktower.jinx.summoner-zombuul: If the Summoner summons a dead player into the Zombuul, the Zombuul has already "died once".
clocktower.jinx.vizier-zealot: The Zealot might register as evil to the Vizier.

clocktower.role.fortuneteller.other_nigh: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).

clocktower.role.ravenkeeper.other_night: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight, the Ravenkeeper chooses a player. Show that player's character token.

clocktower.role.spy.first_night: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
clocktower.role.spy.other_night: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
clocktower.role.undertaker.other_night: If a player was executed today, show their character token.
clocktower.role.washerwoman.first_night: Show the Townsfolk character token. Point to both the *TOWNSFOLK* and *WRONG* players.
clocktower.role.alchemist.first_night: Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Minion token.
clocktower.role.alhadikhia.other_night: The Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 players. In order, wake each target. They nod or shake their head. Put them to sleep before waking the next target.
clocktower.role.amnesiac.first_night: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
clocktower.role.amnesiac.other_night: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
clocktower.role.angel.first_night: Announce which players are protected by the Angel.
clocktower.role.apprentice.first_night: Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then a Townsfolk or Minion token. Swap the Apprentice & Townsfolk or Minion tokens.
clocktower.role.assassin.other_night: The Assassin might choose a player.
clocktower.role.balloonist.other_night: Point to a player with a different character type to the previously shown player.
clocktower.role.banshee.other_night: If the Banshee was killed by the Demon tonight, announce that the Banshee has died.

clocktower.role.barista.first_night: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal.
clocktower.role.barista.other_night: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal.
clocktower.role.boffin.first_night: Wake the Boffin and the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Boffin tokens, then the not-in-play good character token.
clocktower.role.bonecollector.other_nigh: The Bone Collector might choose a dead player. If necessary, wake the chosen player to use their ability.
clocktower.role.bountyhunter.other_night: If the player marked *KNOW* died today or tonight, point to the new player marked *KNOW*.
clocktower.role.buddhist.first_night: Announce which players are affected by the Buddhist.
clocktower.role.cacklejack.other_night: Before dawn, choose a player not marked *NOT ME*. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.cerenovus.first_night: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
clocktower.role.cerenovus.other_night: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
clocktower.role.chambermaid.first_night: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
clocktower.role.chambermaid.other_night: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
clocktower.role.choirboy.other_night: If the Demon killed the King, point to the Demon player.
clocktower.role.courtier.first_night: The Courtier might choose a character.
clocktower.role.courtier.other_night: The Courtier might choose a character.

clocktower.role.cultleader.other_night: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.

clocktower.role.damsel.other_night: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.dawn.first_night: Wait for a few seconds. End the Night Phase.
clocktower.role.dawn.other_night: Wait for a few seconds. End the Night Phase.

clocktower.role.devilsadvocate.first_nig: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player.
clocktower.role.devilsadvocate.other_nig: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player.

clocktower.role.dreamer.other_night: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
clocktower.role.duchess.other_night: One at a time: Wake each player marked *VISITOR* or *FALSE INFO*. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Duchess tokens, then give a finger signal.
clocktower.role.engineer.first_night: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.engineer.other_night: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

clocktower.role.exorcist.other_night: The Exorcist chooses a player. Put the Exorcist to sleep. If the Exorcist chose the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Exorcist tokens. Point to the Exorcist.
clocktower.role.fanggu.other_night: The Fang Gu chooses a player. If they chose an Outsider (once only): Replace the Outsider token with the spare Fang Gu token. Put the Fang Gu to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Fang Gu tokens & give a thumbs-down.
clocktower.role.farmer.other_night: If the Farmer died tonight, wake a living good player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Farmer token.
clocktower.role.fearmonger.first_night: The Fearmonger chooses a player. Announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
clocktower.role.fearmonger.other_night: The Fearmonger chooses a player. If the target is different to last night, announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
clocktower.role.flowergirl.other_night: Either nod or shake your head.
clocktower.role.gambler.other_night: The Gambler chooses a player & a character.
clocktower.role.godfather.first_night: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.
clocktower.role.godfather.other_night: If an Outsider died today, the Godfather chooses a player.
clocktower.role.gossip.other_night: If the Gossip is due to kill a player, they die.
clocktower.role.grandmother.first_night: Point to the grandchild player & show their character token.
clocktower.role.grandmother.other_night: If the grandchild was killed by the Demon, the Grandmother dies too.
clocktower.role.harlot.other_night: The Harlot chooses a living player. Put the Harlot to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, then the Harlot token. clocktower.role.harpy.other_night: The Harpy chooses 2 players. Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.
clocktower.role.hatter.other_night: If the Hatter died, wake the Minions & Demons. Each may choose a new character. If they do, show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.huntsman.first_night: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.huntsman.other_night: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.kazali.first_night: The Kazali chooses which players are which Minions. Wake each target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
clocktower.role.king.first_night: Wake the Demon: Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & King tokens, then point to the King.
clocktower.role.king.other_night: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, show the character token of a living player.
clocktower.role.leviathan.first_night: Announce that the Leviathan is in play.
clocktower.role.leviathan.other_night: Change the Leviathan reminder token to the relevant day. You may announce that the Leviathan is in play.
clocktower.role.lilmonsta.first_night: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens.
clocktower.role.lilmonsta.other_night: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens. A player might die.
clocktower.role.lordoftyphon.first_night: Wake the Lord of Typhon's neighbors. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
clocktower.role.lordoftyphon.other_night: The Lord of Typhon chooses a player.

clocktower.role.marionette.first_night: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Marionette tokens. Point to the Marionette.
clocktower.role.mezepheles.other_night: If a good player said the secret word, wake the player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumbs-down.
clocktower.role.minioninfo.first_night: If there are 7 or more players, wake all Minions: Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the other Minions.
clocktower.role.moonchild.other_night: If the Moonchild is due to kill a good player, they die.
clocktower.role.nightwatchman.first_nigh: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman.
clocktower.role.nightwatchman.other_nigh: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman.
clocktower.role.nodashii.other_night: The No Dashii chooses a player.
clocktower.role.organgrinder.first_night: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober.
clocktower.role.organgrinder.other_night: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober.
clocktower.role.philosopher.first_night: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token.
clocktower.role.philosopher.other_night: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token.
clocktower.role.pithag.other_night: The Pit-Hag chooses a player & a character. If they chose a character that is not in play: Put the Pit-Hag to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.
clocktower.role.pixie.first_night: Show the Townsfolk character token marked *MAD*.
clocktower.role.plaguedoctor.other_night: If the Plague Doctor died, the Storyteller gained a Minion ability. If you haven’t done this yet, do so now.
clocktower.role.po.other_night: The Po may choose a player OR chooses 3 players if they chose no-one last night. or

clocktower.role.poppygrower.other_night: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake all Minions. Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the Minions.
clocktower.role.preacher.first_night: The Preacher chooses a player. If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
clocktower.role.preacher.other_night: The Preacher chooses a player. If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
clocktower.role.princess.other_night: If the Princess nominated the player who was executed today, wake the Demon as normal, but no one dies to the Demon's ability.
clocktower.role.professor.other_night: The Professor might choose a dead player.
clocktower.role.pukka.other_night: The Pukka chooses a player. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.

clocktower.role.sage.other_night: If the Demon killed the Sage, wake the Sage and point to 2 players, 1 of which is the Demon.

clocktower.role.sailor.other_night: The Sailor chooses a living player.

clocktower.role.wizard.first_night: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.

clocktower.role.wraith.other_night: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.

clocktower.ui.changelog.body: BotC v1.6.0 - August 29, 2026%n%%n%Changes and features:%n%- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.11.%n%- Added a radial menu (opened with C by default) to quickly select nominator and nominee without having to open the Grimoire.%n%- Added the ability to import a script from a file.%n%- Added the ability to view Fabled and Lorics in the script menu.%n%- Added functionality to not reveal player's roles if the Tor is in play.%n%- Added an alert that appears in the bag screen if you have selected a role that affects setup.%n%- Added a particle for when regular votes are cast.%n%- Added some greenery to the Church exterior.%n%- Added a Storyteller "Quick Actions" menu opened via hotkey (R by default). This contains several options with sub-menus:%n%  - Toggle Gamemode%n%  - Teleport...%n%    - Minions and Demons to church%n%    - Players to seats%n%    - Players to homes%n%  - Teleport self to house%n%  - Special abilities%n%    - Toggle Organ Grinder ability%n%    - Toggle Banshee ability%n%    - Announce Al-Hadikhia targets%n%    - Activate Ferryman ability%n%  - Announce%n%    - Leviathan%n%    - Boomdandy countdown%n%    - Fearmonger selection%n%    - Banshee death%n%  - Nominate%n%  - Execute%n%- Added an option to pause the timer during nominations%n%- Added an onboarding message after clicking "Use this Bag"%n%- Added an alert on the main menu when you are using a beta version.%n%- Added a small, translucent version number in the pause menu.%n%- Added a documentation link on first join.%n%- Setup tutorial messages now refer to the player's username instead of <player>.%n%- Added No Chat Restrictions to eliminate ridiculous multiplayer restrictions for players in some regions.%n%- Added the BetterTab mod.%n%%n%- The bag menu has been totally redone, notably eliminating the need for the Fix Leftover Roles button. The current layout is not very colorblind-friendly and will be improved further in the future.%n%- Players can now whisper to their neighbors and to Storytellers while seated using /whisper. When a game is not active, anyone can whisper to anyone. These messages are always visible to Storytellers.%n%- Players can now optionally join a voice chat with all players at night. Toggle between this and the private local voice chat with a keybind (ENTER by default).%n%- A ✎ icon now appears at the end of the voice chat participant list if a Storyteller is present.%n%- The house voice chats will now send a "you have joined X voice chat" message during the day.%n%- Many commands now check that a game is active before they can be run.%n%- Many commands that are not relevant to the game are hidden for non-ops.%n%- /tell (and its aliases) are now disabled for non-Storytellers.%n%- Storytellers no longer need to be opped in order to Storytell. A server operator will still need to be the one to add or remove a Storyteller.%n%- Storytellers can now click "mark" or "remove mark" to update that status and cancel a nomination immediately.%n%- A new clock arm displays which player nominated. This info is also printed in chat.%n%- "Requesting Storyteller Chat" is now automatically toggled off when a Storyteller is in the same room as you.%n%- A shorter clock tick sound plays during voting if the clock speed is one second or lower.%n%- Your character is now revealed to you as soon as you enter your house, instead of the Storyteller having to do it.%n%- The Night Order display within the Grimoire is now much more compact.%n%- Hovering over a character token in the Night Order within the Grimoire will now display instructions for what to do with that character.%n%- The Change Character and Change Bluff screens now display character names and descriptions when a token is hovered over.%n%- Beds & carpets in the mint, navy, and lavender houses are now appropriately colored.%n%- When creating a server, you no longer need to move any additional files.%n%- When creating a server, you no longer need to run /reload and YAWP commands.%n%- Players can now interact with any blocks that do not change the map state (i.e. chests, beds, lecterns).%n%- Players now get a slight speed boost when coming to town in the morning and returning home at night.%n%- Silenced the Cyan House's sheep. :)%n%%n%- Removed the "modpack is in an early state, look out for bugs" warning on the pause menu.%n%%n%Technical changes:%n%- Character string IDs are now the same as TPI's (i.e. pit_hag is now pithag). Resource packs containing character icons will need to be updated.%n%- Character numerical IDs are now in alphabetical order and categorized by character type. The alphabetical order will most likely not be maintained when new characters are added, they'll just be tacked on the end.%n%  - 001-199: Townsfolk%n%  - 200-299: Outsiders%n%  - 300-399: Minions%n%  - 400-499: Demons%n%  - 500-599: Travellers%n%  - 600-699: NPCs%n%- Timer functions moved to util folder as they're grabbed from a lot of different spots.%n%- Many texts are now translation strings. This is not yet comprehensive.%n%- Voice chat management now uses predicates instead of block detection so as to allow for vertical and float-based sizing (except for the crop fields as I was lazy).%n%- Voice chat player list actionbars are now stored in world NBT data.%n%- Storyteller permission checks to run commands are now within the functions instead of the command's .json file.%n%- TAB mod has been removed in favor of Show Your Identity, which is much less buggy and lets pronouns be seen at a greater distance.%n%- Script data is no longer stored on players, and is now exclusively stored and referenced in ct:script%n%- Voting strength now correlates to a score instead of a strict +1%n%- "Dev Mode" is now a little more official. If active, /reloads and joining the world does not automatically run init functions.%n%- The way scripts are imported has been redone, making it dramatically more efficient and laying groundwork for homebrew support in the future.%n%- All decorational armor stands are now item displays.%n%- Block protection is now handled using Flan instead of YAWP. This means that if you have your own map, you'll need to re-define claims where players are able to toggle doors. Check config/flan/flan_config to set an item with which to do so.%n%- The biome datapack is now baked into the core datapack instead of being inside the world.%n%- User-facing data like ghost votes and player count is now stored in FM variables and NBT storage as well as in scores so that modern FancyMenu can read them.%n%- Optimized many steps in the nominations phase of the game.%n%- Removed unused file references from carrot_on_a_stick.json%n%- Added min_format and max_format to datapack.%n%%n%Fixed bugs:%n%- #4: The bottom right "Since ..." uses the Storyteller's timezone.%n%- #28: Fabled, Loric, and Traveller characters do not add reminder tokens to the Grimoire.%n%- #57: The script and Grimoire cannot be opened while a nomination is active.%n%- #64: Not all windows in the yellow house get blocked by particles.%n%- #65: Teleport to player home is broken in the new map.%n%- #70: Block sounds are not muted on nights 1 and 3.%n%- #78: A shorter clock tick sound should play if voting speed is fast enough that the regular one would overlap with itself.%n%- #80: Starting a game with more than 15 non-ST players in the lobby breaks the game.%n%- #83: Reminder tokens are broken for player 13, 14, and 15. (thanks @LordWoolfy!)%n%- #87: Compasses not handed out on night one.%n%- #96: Player Names are incorrectly formatted in the Al-Had announcement due to Markdown. (thanks @Jvkeh!)%n%- #97: Non-Storytellers using the /grimoire command open the Storyteller Grim.%n%- #99: Spectators get given Village Idiot/Legion tokens. (thanks @Jvkeh!)%n%- #132: Players can escape the pyre while being executed.%n%- #141: Resetting the game doesnt remove the current nomination%n%- #164: Disable Enhanced Groups group summary setting%n%- Players dying during the day doesn't update alive player/dead votes count in the Grimoire.%n%- The button to change seat 15's character is clickable when there are not 15 players.%n%- Custom banner patterns refer to a nonexistent translation string.%n%- The Acrobat is missing a * in its character description.%n%- The Virgin lacks a "no ability" reminder token.%n%- There are several accessible holes in the terrain.%n%- Some voice chats can be entered or left by standing in non-whole blocks (panes, iron bars, fences).%n%- Spectator 👁️ in voice chats icon uses the wrong font.%n%- Players disconnecting from the server screws up the player count in the Grimoire.%n%- Many instances of "gray" are spelled as "grey."%n%- Lavender and Pink arrows are in the wrong order on a sign.%n%- Players can craft any combination of the Setup Bag, Grimoire, and Script together to get a Carrot on a Stick.
